reviews.text: I am now taking my third pup to J9's K9s, the first being nearly 20 years ago!  My family and friends have also been to their classes.  The teach with patience and love, and their methods work!  They also help with emails between classes to talk you down when your puppy is driving you nuts :).  I highly recommend!!

We had the BEST experience with J9’s K9s Dog Training. Vic is truly incredible. We came in with what I lovingly call our “land shark” — nonstop energy, zero chill, and absolutely convinced she ran the house. 😅
Vic was patient, calm, and so knowledgeable. She didn’t just train our puppy — she trained us on how to communicate clearly and consistently. The transformation has been amazing. We now have structure, better behavior, and most importantly, a happier, more confident pup.
If you have a strong-willed breed (or just a wild little tornado), I cannot recommend J9's K9s enough.We’re so grateful!

The trainers are very knowledgeable and I loved how positive the training techniques are at J9sK9s. I was very happy with the structure and pace of the puppy head start class.  I could see that every dog was beginning to shine by the end of this course.

As I live almost an hour away, there are plenty of dog trainers closer to my house. I'm so glad I did some research and found J9sK9s. Schedule permitting,  I hope to take many more courses.

Edited to add:
I have now been going to J9sk9s for 6 years. We have enjoyed puppy head start, beginning obedience, intermediate obedience, advanced obedience, intro to tricks, intermediate tricks, advanced tricks, master tricks, intro to agility, and advanced intro to agility. My dogs and I have loved every class and it keeps their brains engaged. I highly recommend J9sK9s!
Great training been coming here for years. And whenever I have an issue I can call and get help.... forever!

My puppy and I just graduated from Puppy school and we had a great time!  Janine, Vic, Izzy & Hudson were very helpful and patient with me as a new mom to an active/playful puppy!  They help put my nerves at ease and offered soooo many helpful tips!I will be continuing my classes with J9 K9 Dog Training...hope to move up!

We loved our obedience school training here highly recommend a fair price, great teachers, we were able to find something that fit our schedule and when we weren’t able to make it, they recorded the class for us

The training at Janine’s school has really has been super effective! My dog was initially very nervous in almost all situations, but working here has helped both my dog and me to build better behaviors. Would highly recommend this school!
